_note: One 'In short' line per gate, shown at the top of each gate in the reading. Approved by The Völva. To hide a line, set "ok": false; to change one, edit its text.

1.short: Making things as a kind of devotion, and keeping at it whether or not inspiration shows up.

2.short: Knowing which way to go, and growing that path so well that others want to follow it.

3.short: Bringing order to something brand new while it's still messy, and doing it where people can see.

4.short: Coming up with answers, and enjoying the questions more than being right.

5.short: Keeping a daily rhythm that feeds you, rather than one you just put up with.

6.short: Choosing who to let close, and using conflict to make the bond better.

7.short: Leading as someone who carries a role for others, and planting direction in people so they move on their own.

8.short: Finding where your work truly belongs, and staying long enough to weave it in.

9.short: Breaking a huge job into small pieces, and finding the one that actually matters.

10.short: Being yourself, at your own size, without performing; that's what makes you hard to knock down.

11.short: Having ideas to give away, so other people can think better, without needing to carry them out yourself.

12.short: Speaking when people are ready to hear it, which is why your words land so hard when they do.

13.short: Listening in a way that heals, while making sure someone is looking after you too.

14.short: Winning resources and then using them for the people around you, not for show.

15.short: Making room for people who move too fast or too slow, including yourself on your up and down days.

16.short: Getting good at something by practising with real enthusiasm, and noticing when you've got it.

17.short: Seeing how things should be organised, and offering that view only when it's actually wanted.

18.short: Fixing what's been handed down with care for it, and knowing when something should be let go instead.

19.short: Sensing what people need and actually providing it, from a place where your own needs are met.

20.short: Saying what's true right now, simply and clearly, while you're paying full attention.

21.short: Taking charge quickly when something needs fixing, then handing control back once it's done.

22.short: Making a room feel good by noticing what each person actually needs.

23.short: Taking a strange new idea and putting it in words other people can grow something from.

24.short: Going over the same thoughts until you've sorted what's worth keeping and given it room to grow.

25.short: Loving without keeping score, through endings and new beginnings alike.

26.short: Selling an idea honestly, to people you actually know, by showing how to get from here to there.

27.short: Caring for people in a way that makes them stronger, not more dependent.

28.short: Fighting for something that means something, and knowing what you're fighting for.

29.short: Saying yes with your whole self, but only to what you really want, and on clear terms.

30.short: Wanting things deeply, and pointing that wanting at something worth burning for.

31.short: Leading with your voice, aware of the people who held the role before you.

32.short: Sensing what will last, and backing it through the lean years.

33.short: Stepping back to remember and learn from what happened, then telling the story when the time is right.

34.short: Using your strength to clear away what needs to go, so something new can grow.

35.short: Wanting new experiences and living each one fully before moving on.

36.short: Getting through hard times and then helping other people through theirs.

37.short: Being steady and warm for your family, with fair, spoken agreements about what each person gives.

38.short: Standing up for what matters, and using the disagreement to understand the other person better.

39.short: Poking people just enough to wake them up to what they care about.

40.short: Working hard on a fair deal, and actually taking the rest and thanks you've earned.

41.short: Starting things: picking the dream worth chasing, and taking the first real step.

42.short: Finishing things properly, so what you've learned carries into what comes next.

43.short: Knowing something deep down, keeping it safe until it's ready, and then saying it with authority.

44.short: Spotting people's patterns and talents, and helping them land where they'll do well.

45.short: Gathering resources, and then sharing them with the people you're responsible for.

46.short: Living fully in your body: listening to what it needs, and building a life that suits it.

47.short: Working through confusing memories bit by bit until they start to make sense.

48.short: Sharing what you know freely and early, before you feel completely ready.

49.short: Changing the rules when they stop working, and drawing a fairer circle of who belongs.

50.short: Looking after the values and rules that keep a group healthy, and testing them to see they still work.

51.short: Shaking people awake on purpose, and staying around to help afterwards.

52.short: Being still in a way that's restful and focused, and taking in the bigger picture.

53.short: Starting things that are worth committing to, and following through on what you start.

54.short: Being ambitious without shame, and rising by really listening to the people who help you.

55.short: Riding your moods, the fiery highs and the heavy lows, without thinking either one is the whole truth.

56.short: Telling stories that draw people in, and letting them mean more as you grow.

57.short: Trusting your gut about what's coming, and acting on it in small ways straight away.

58.short: Enjoying making things better, one clear, winnable improvement at a time.

59.short: Getting close to people openly and warmly, on honest terms.

60.short: Accepting your limits and getting creative inside them.

61.short: Listening deeply for what's true, and then passing it on.

62.short: Finding the right words for things, so feelings and ideas can actually be worked with.

63.short: Questioning everything fairly, your own ideas included, so things can get better.

64.short: Letting confusing ideas settle on their own until they make sense, without panicking.
